summary:
Here are the key developments with insight, 4-6 bullet points, and 1 trend:

**Key Developments:**

• NVIDIA has expanded its Agent Toolkit with new Omniverse libraries, enabling AI agents to build simulation-ready worlds.
• OpenAI has released GPT-Red, an automated red teaming system that uses self-play to improve AI safety, alignment, and prompt injection robustness.
• Thinking Machines Lab has dropped its first model, Inkling, a 975-billion-parameter open source model trained to understand video and audio.
• NVIDIA has partnered with Japan's government and industrial leaders to launch the world's first national AI infrastructure.
• NVIDIA has introduced new Jetson Thor computers to advance mainstream robotics and edge AI.
• Japan's enterprises and startups are building industry-specialized AI using NVIDIA's Nemotron open models.

**Trend:** **Fast expansion of AI infrastructure and technologies in Japan**

Japan is becoming a hub for AI development, with NVIDIA's partnership with the Japanese government and industries leading to the launch of the world's first national AI infrastructure. This is in line with the country's goal to become a leader in AI adoption and development. Japan's enterprises and startups are also leveraging NVIDIA's Nemotron open models to build industry-specialized AI, indicating a growing interest in AI adoption in various sectors.
